summary: Detailed analysis of 6 new feature requests for the Leave Tracker delegation and substitute approval system. Maps each request to the current codebase architecture, identifies what already exists (CTO→GM delegation, OM/HOD line manager dropdown), what needs to be built (CEO absence bypass, GM→OM substitution with auto-skip, substitute notifications), and raises 4 critical open questions that need user clarification before implementation can proceed. Includes current vs proposed workflow diagrams and a changes summary table.
